 Cookies With Mrs. Claus Coming Up Saturday in Lavonia
 November 20, 2026 MJ Kneiser 
 If you’re looking for a fun event to do with your children a local Lavonia volunteer group is hosting Cookies with Mrs. Claus Saturday at the Lavonia Community Center on Bear Creek Rd.
 Sponsored by the Greater Lavonia Community, the event Saturday is for children ages 4 – 10.
 Children will help Mrs. Claus decorate Christmas cookies.
 Admission is $5 per child, which is payable when you arrive.
 Registration is required so they know how many cookies and decorating items to bring and have ready.
 All proceeds will go to help support this year’s Toys for Tots.
 A link to a registration form can be found on the Greater Lavonia Community Facebook page.
